name: My-Portfolio
description: Modern, high-performance developer portfolio built with Astro, TypeScript, and responsive CSS. Features case-study showcases and optimized asset bundling

paragraphs: The source code for my personal engineering portfolio, built to highlight distributed systems architecture, microservices engineering, and full-stack projects. Engineered with Astro for zero-JS-by-default runtime performance, fast static page generation, and optimized media delivery.
features: Zero-Runtime Overhead: Built on Astro's static site generation (SSG) architecture, serving pre-rendered HTML/CSS with instant first-contentful paint (FCP).
Curated Technical Case Studies: Deep dives into featured projects including PulseCare (Spring Boot Microservices & K8s) and Greenvy (AI-powered SDG 12 Web App).
Categorized Competencies: Segmented skill matrix organizing backend systems, cloud orchestration, web technologies, and QA tools.
Optimized Media Pipeline: Utilizes Astro's native image optimization to compress and convert assets to modern formats on the fly.
Accessible & Mobile Responsive: Fluid responsive layouts with a dedicated mobile drawer navigation and dark-mode aesthetic.

Engineered with Astro for zero-JS-by-default runtime performance, fast static page generation, and optimized media delivery.
